about.built_on: This app is built on Sefaria's open-source mobile app, used under the GNU General Public License, version 3.
about.licences: Each text keeps its own licence (for example public domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA). Open "About this text" while reading to see the source and licence of what you are reading.
about.soferbooks_intro: SoferBooks Library is a free app for reading the classic Jewish texts on your phone. No account is needed: your reading history and saved texts stay on this device.
about.source_code: SoferBooks Library source code (GPL-3.0, based on Sefaria's app)
about.texts_courtesy: The texts are courtesy of their sources: chiefly Sefaria's free library (sefaria.org), and the publishers, editors and translators credited on each text.

filter.description: Hides books, commentaries and translations by group. Each level hides everything the one before it hides, and more. Switching a group by hand makes the filter "Custom".
filter.group_religious_zionist_thought_s: Rav Kook, Rav Soloveitchik, Nechama Leibowitz
filter.hidden_message: {title} is hidden by your content filter ({reason}). You can change the filter in Settings.
full_library.description: Choose the parts to keep on this phone. The books of the other libraries download one at a time in the background.

learning_schedules.description: Since biblical times, the Torah has been divided into sections which are read each week on a set yearly calendar. Following this practice, many other calendars have been created to help communities of learners work through specific texts together.
library_sources.description: Each source is a separate download.
reader.inline_connections: Connections (the texts linked to each line)
reader.nakdan_ask_text: Add nikud by computer, with Dicta's Nakdan? It is usually right, but it can make mistakes.
settings.open_sefaria_links: Open Sefaria links in this app
settings.open_sefaria_links_explanation: Android cannot confirm that sefaria.org links belong to this app, so you turn this on yourself: on the page that opens, tap “Open by default”, then turn on “Open supported links”.
settings.nakdan_always_detail: To every text without it, while vowels are shown. Each sefer's own switch is in the reader's display menu (Aa).
settings.nakdan_credit: Nikud by Dicta's Nakdan (dicta.org.il), used with permission. It can make mistakes.
settings.turning_this_feature_off: Turning this feature off will permanently delete your reading history.
